abstract: Purpose Pancreatic adenocarcinoma (PAAD) is a highly aggressive malignancy, and constitutive NF-κB activation is a key driver of its progression; however, the upstream mechanisms remain poorly defined. NOP10, a core component of the H/ACA small nucleolar ribonucleoprotein complex, is overexpressed in PAAD and promotes malignant phenotypes, but whether it drives NF-κB signaling through a specific effector is unknown. This study aimed to determine whether NOP10 activates NF-κB through TRAF1 to promote pancreatic cancer progression. Methods NOP10 expression and prognosis were analyzed in TCGA-PAAD, GTEx, and GEO datasets. PANC-1 and 8988T cells were subjected to NOP10 knockdown, NOP10 overexpression, and TRAF1 restoration, followed by proliferation, colony formation, wound healing, and Transwell invasion assays, RNA sequencing, and enrichment analyses. Reciprocal co-immunoprecipitation and GST pull-down assays were used to test protein interactions. Results NOP10 was upregulated in PAAD tissues and cells and correlated with poor overall survival. Knockdown of NOP10 suppressed proliferation, migration, and invasion, whereas overexpression exerted opposite effects. RNA sequencing identified TRAF1 as a key NOP10-regulated gene. NOP10 positively regulated TRAF1 expression, and the two proteins directly interacted. In PANC-1 cells, TRAF1 restoration reversed NOP10 knockdown-induced downregulation of p-p65 and p50, increased IκBα expression, and rescued proliferation, migration, and invasion. Conclusion These results demonstrate that NOP10 directly binds TRAF1 to activate NF-κB signaling, thereby promoting pancreatic cancer progression and providing a potential therapeutic target.
key_points_ko: NOP10은 췌장선암(PAAD) 조직과 세포에서 발현이 증가되어 있으며 불량한 전체 생존기간(overall survival)과 연관됩니다.
NOP10 억제는 세포의 증식, 이동, 침투를 억제한 반면, 과발현은 반대 효과를 나타냈습니다.
NOP10은 TRAF1과 직접 상호작용하여 p-p65와 p50의 인산화를 조절하고 NF-κB 신호를 활성화합니다.
summary_ko: 이 연구는 췌장선암(PAAD)에서 NOP10이 TRAF1과의 직접적인 결합을 통해 NF-κB 신호전달 경로를 활성화하고 암의 진행을 촉진하는 기전을 규명했습니다. TCGA-PAAD, GTEx, GEO 데이터 분석 및 PANC-1, 8988T 세포주 실험을 통해 NOP10의 과발현이 세포 증식, 이동, 침투를 촉진하며 나쁜 전체 생존기간(OS)과 연관됨을 확인했습니다. NOP10 억제 시 이러한 악성 표현형이 억제되었고, TRAF1의 재발현을 통해 다시 회복되었습니다. 초록에 명시되지 않음
title: NOP10 Directly Interacts with TRAF1 to Activate NF-κB Signalling and Promote Pancreatic Cancer Progression
title_ko: NOP10은 TRAF1과 직접 상호작용하여 NF-κB 신호를 활성화하고 췌장암 진행을 촉진합니다
